actual: C-011-P2-3-A formal spike completed all 144 market development fits but failed with hmm_risk_jump_selection_unavailable. _run_component computes six lambda_receipts with per-fold selection metrics, then _select_lambda raises without attaching them; run_p2_3_spike persists only fit_attempts. The durable failure receipt therefore cannot identify which fold metric or typed reason made every lambda ineligible and forces an expensive refit. Preserve immutable lambda/fold metric evidence and hashes in the typed failure receipt without changing lambda eligibility, thresholds, selection, holdout access, fit count, model/READY, database, or runtime semantics.
